items.title: A subcollection of opens satisfying a covering and intersection condition defines a quotient-like map to a space with those opens as a basis
items.author: The Stacks Project Authors
items.source_version: Stacks Project git a04446e57ec1 (2026-07-28); file topology.tex; corpus local snapshot 20261012
items.difficulty_reason: The counted statement shows that a collection of opens covering the space and satisfying the intersection condition induces a continuous map onto a space in which the images of the collection form a basis and are exactly the preimages of their images (author lemma at source lines 593-607, label lemma-create-map-from-subcollection). The proof (source lines 609-623) defines the equivalence relation of having the same members containing a point, observes that the hypotheses mirror the basis criterion for the family of images and reads off the three assertions (proof lines 609-622). The equivalence relation and the transport of the basis criterion are the content. H3.
